Woman's layoff video after 5.5 years at Wipro goes viral

A marketing professional from Delhi, Anukriti Vidyarthi, has gained significant online attention after sharing a video detailing her layoff from Wipro after five and a half years. Her candid account of losing job security and facing the prospect of starting over resonated widely on social media, with many users expressing empathy and relating to her experience.
